headline: AMBER (RHR 52, sleep 5.9h): today's run was short but fine. Race taper unchanged, Friday's strides now depend on how you wake up
summary: Today you ran 19min / 3.5km, avg HR 138, max 161, RPE 1, feel 3 (Normal), load 14. The plan was 23min easy + 4x20s strides + 2min (~30min, load 25). Max HR 161 means the strides weren't run (target 175-185). The easy part sat right in the 138-150 band. In practice you used the travel-day stop rule (20min, no strides). That's acceptable today, nothing to make up. Cadence 80.6 (~161 spm) is fine for a jog. Readiness: HRV 63 (62 yesterday, no drop), but RHR 52 (49 yesterday) and sleep 5.9h (score 66). The RHR alone makes today amber. That fits the travel day and short night, not fatigue from training. Load: CTL 55.0, ATL 54.5, so form is already about +0.5. With Friday's 15 load, race morning should land around TSB +5 with CTL about 54, inside the +2 to +5 target. Wed openers delivered 31 vs 35. Week so far: 70 / 36 / 31 / 14. Taper stays as planned. The amber rule only adds a gate to Friday's shakeout. Tonight: sleep is the limiter. Early dinner and lights out early, carb loading 7-8 g/kg as planned.
flags: RHR 52 is the first reading of 52+ since 26 Oct. If it is 52+ again Friday with sleep under 6h, run Friday's 15min with no strides.
Strides skipped today: don't add them Friday unless readiness is back to green.
Race day: 165 cap for the first 20min, 166 is a ceiling from km 10. On 29 Oct rep 2 went past the 168 stop rule.
